_purpose: OWLv2 single-config JOINT grid, pooled mAP@50 over all 13 conditions. CHARACTERIZATION, not an expected win: OWLv2-TRUST(health_gate) sits at ~parity below its own vanilla (0.2377 vs 0.2540 pooled). OWLv2's posterior is FLAT (softmax-over-sigmoid), so TRUST's headroom is limited to reducing CACHE POLLUTION. This grid centers on cache-admission levers (tau1, tau1_rare_class_reduction, max_cache_size) + the fusion threshold — the one place a config MIGHT help. If flat, parity is the ceiling; the grid is deliberately SMALL (54 combos) to confirm saturation, not chase it.
_runner: MUST be run with grid_search/narval/grid_search_runner_multidet.py (the stock grid_search_runner.py hardcodes GroundingDINODetector and cannot run OWLv2).
_stack: PINNED transformers==4.57.6. Fixed: native_candidate_selection=true (dense-anchor, avoids query flood), health_gate_untracked=true (safe lever), detector.threshold=0.1, iou=0.7. data_root + detector.model_path are injected at run time by the sbatch (top-level).

_grid_design.current_value_in_every_set: tau1=0.8, rare_reduction=0.3, cache=25, fusion_conf=0.7 all present -> frozen config is in the grid
_grid_design.chunk_axis: adaptation.params.tau1 (first swept param, length 3) -> 3 array chunks x 18 configs
_grid_design.expectation: likely flat / parity-bound; a small cache-pollution win is the only plausible upside
